name: Velociraptor_KillProcess
author: SOC-3s (adapted from Wes Lambert, @therealwlambert)
description: Kill a process on a Velociraptor-enrolled endpoint using exact executable-path matching. Triggered on a process-path observable; resolves the target endpoint via the parent case hostname/endpoint-ip observables.

configurationItems.name: velociraptor_client_config
configurationItems.description: Path to Velociraptor API client config file

configurationItems.name: velociraptor_client_config_content_base64
configurationItems.description: Base64-encoded Velociraptor API client config file (YAML). Recommended for containerized deployments.

configurationItems.name: thehive_apikey
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with read access to case observables

configurationItems.name: really_do_it
configurationItems.description: If false (default), dry-run only — reports what would be killed without killing. Set true only after end-to-end verification.
